entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I had invited Vina on a yacht trip..."
entries.dialogueText: I had invited Vina on a yacht trip from Topes out to view the Esqiris gas field.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was curious how progress on the e..."
entries.dialogueText: I was curious how progress on the expansion I'd ordered was coming along. And it had been a long time since my daughter and I had talked.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I hadn't visited since its expansio..."
entries.dialogueText: I hadn't visited since its expansion had been completed. And it had been a long time since my daughter and I had talked.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After several decades of operation,..."
entries.dialogueText: After several decades of operation, it was to be decommissioned and turned into a marine reserve. I was curious about the project, and it had been a long time since my daughter and I had talked.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Rizania was anchored a few hund..."
entries.dialogueText: The Rizania was anchored a few hundred meters offshore. I stood on the aft deck, awaiting Vina's arrival.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Claiming she was tired of being hou..."
entries.dialogueText: Claiming she was tired of being hounded by the press, she'd asked to take a dinghy incognito from a nearby port.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She secured the boat and climbed ou..."
entries.dialogueText: She secured the boat and climbed out to join me on the deck, followed by Manus Sazon.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What a pleasant surprise. Vina, wh..."
entries.dialogueText: "What a pleasant surprise. Vina, why didn't you tell me you'd be bringing company?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You. How dare you even show your f..."
entries.dialogueText: "You. How dare you even show your face in front of me?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Relax, Mr. Sazon. I know coming he..."
entries.dialogueText: "Relax, Mr. Sazon. I know coming here wasn't your idea."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Are you two insane? Do you want to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you two insane? Do you want to add fuel to the rumors?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He broke into a smile."
entries.dialogueText: He broke into a smile.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They looked at each other."
entries.dialogueText: They looked at each other.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Your daughter is a hard woman to s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your daughter is a hard woman to say no to. But you know that more than I do."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina breathed a sigh of relief."
entries.dialogueText: Vina breathed a sigh of relief.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I'm sorry, Father. I wasn't sure h..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry, Father. I wasn't sure how you would react."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina swiftly stepped between us."
entries.dialogueText: Vina swiftly stepped between us.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""He didn't want to come today, Fath..."
entries.dialogueText: "He didn't want to come today, Father. I convinced him."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""That's partly why I asked him to j..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's partly why I asked him to join us, Father."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I wanted a chance for the three of..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wanted a chance for the three of us to speak in private. Out of the way of the press."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""There are certain conversations re..."
entries.dialogueText: "There are certain conversations regarding Rizia's direction that have yet to be followed up on."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus cleared his throat."
entries.dialogueText: Manus cleared his throat.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Apologies, Mr. Sazon. This yacht h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Apologies, Mr. Sazon. This yacht has seen better days."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Aye, she's beginning to show her a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Aye, she's beginning to show her age, but she's a fine vessel."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's about time I had my ship rest..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's about time I had my ship restored."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""It's a sight grander than the scho..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's a sight grander than the schooner my mother and I used to putter around in."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""She looks beautiful, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "She looks beautiful, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Our country shouldn't have to pay..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our country shouldn't have to pay for the upkeep of the King's luxury vessel. Don't you think so, Mr. Sazon?"

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Ah, well, if the King sees the uti..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ah, well, if the King sees the utility in maintaining such a craft, I would not dare to oppose him."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What a piece of junk. I should hav..."
entries.dialogueText: "What a piece of junk. I should have it scrapped."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Our country shouldn't have to pay..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our country shouldn't have to pay for the upkeep of the King's luxury vessel, anyway. Don't you think so, Mr. Sazon?"

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Ah, well, if the King believes suc..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ah, well, if the King believes such a craft is no longer necessary, I wouldn't dare to disagree with him."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""You're too polite. The Rizania has..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're too polite. The Rizania hasn't been restored since before Mother died."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""But our country shouldn't have to..."
entries.dialogueText: "But our country shouldn't have to pay for the upkeep of the King's luxury vessel. Don't you think so, Mr. Sazon?"

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Ah, well, if the King sees the uti..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ah, well, if the King sees the utility in maintaining such a craft, I would not dare to oppose him."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We settled around a table on the up..."
entries.dialogueText: We settled around a table on the upper deck. A server came around with orange juice and light refreshments.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""So, Father--""
entries.dialogueText: "So, Father--"

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Your Majesty, I--""
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, I--"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They looked at each other and laugh..."
entries.dialogueText: They looked at each other and laughed.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I looked around. We were surrounded..."
entries.dialogueText: I looked around. We were surrounded by open ocean, with the gas field yet to come into view.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Spit it out, you two.""
entries.dialogueText: "Spit it out, you two."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What is it? Your king commands you..."
entries.dialogueText: "What is it? Your king commands you to speak."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus nodded at my daughter."
entries.dialogueText: Manus nodded at my daughter.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I don't think it's a secret that t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't think it's a secret that the two of us connected in Sallabes."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""After our visit to Sallabes, I mad..."
entries.dialogueText: "After our visit to Sallabes, I made the bold step of asking for Mr. Sazon's postal address."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Well, Father...""
entries.dialogueText: "Well, Father..."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""We've been corresponding since the..."
entries.dialogueText: "We've been corresponding since then. And speaking on the phone when we've had time."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Thank you Father. Of course I see..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you Father. Of course I see it the same way, but it means a lot to hear it from you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Because of Pales.""
entries.dialogueText: "Because of Pales."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I confess, I withheld my feelings..."
entries.dialogueText: "I confess, I withheld my feelings at first, fearing reprisal from the King. Yet the more we spoke and wrote, the more I realized what a fool I'd be to walk away from such a beautiful, inspiring woman."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina blushed furiously."
entries.dialogueText: Vina blushed furiously.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""We both know better than to rush i..."
entries.dialogueText: "We both know better than to rush into marriage. But it is our hope that you will give your blessing to our relationship."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No. Absolutely not.""
entries.dialogueText: "No. Absolutely not."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I would love nothing more than to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would love nothing more than to grant my full-throated approval to your bond."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You don't need my blessing. Vina i..."
entries.dialogueText: "You don't need my blessing. Vina is a grown woman and her romantic life is none of my business."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina struggled to remain calm."
entries.dialogueText: Vina struggled to remain calm.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""And why not, Father?""
entries.dialogueText: "And why not, Father?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But I would ask that we only make..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I would ask that we only make the relationship public once Vina returns from Pales."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Because any children this union pr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Because any children this union produces will carry the last name Sazon. The Toras dynasty will be destroyed."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But if this union produces childre..."
entries.dialogueText: "But if this union produces children, it will destroy the Toras dynasty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina's eyes sparkled."
entries.dialogueText: Vina's eyes sparkled.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But I would kindly ask you to cons..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I would kindly ask you to consider going to Pales regardless. I'm sure Mr. Sazon will still be here when you return."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Because your boyfriend here is try..."
entries.dialogueText: "Because your boyfriend here is trying to destroy the Rizian monarchy."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But I do wonder if Mr. Sazon is tr..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I do wonder if Mr. Sazon is truly motivated by love, or by his house's anti-monarchist aims."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As the small craft pulled up alongs..."
entries.dialogueText: As the small craft pulled up alongside my yacht, I realized my daughter wasn't alone.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Hello, Father.""
entries.dialogueText: "Hello, Father."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Yes, greetings, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, greetings, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus bowed. The two of them regard..."
entries.dialogueText: Manus bowed. The two of them regarded me nervously.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good idea. We three have a lot to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good idea. We three have a lot to talk about."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't like this. But seeing as M..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't like this. But seeing as Mr. Sazon came all this way, I'll indulge you both."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I've got time for a short chat. Bu..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've got time for a short chat. But our main purpose is to have a look at the gas field."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Fine. But be glad I'm not beheadin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fine. But be glad I'm not beheading you both for your insolence."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Thank you, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Of course. I won't trouble you for..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course. I won't trouble you for long."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Yes, we do.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, we do."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Your mercy is unparalleled, Your M..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your mercy is unparalleled, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The yacht pulled up anchor and we b..."
entries.dialogueText: The yacht pulled up anchor and we began our journey out to the Esqiris field.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As we ascended to the upper deck, I..."
entries.dialogueText: As we ascended to the upper deck, I noted the Rizania's shabby state of repairs. The paint was peeling in places, and a few of the fixtures were rusted.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Whatever you two have to say, it c..."
entries.dialogueText: "Whatever you two have to say, it can wait. Vina, we need to talk about Pales."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My daughter composed herself. I saw..."
entries.dialogueText: My daughter composed herself. I saw worry in her eyes.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""What about Pales, Father?""
entries.dialogueText: "What about Pales, Father?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""They are requesting a diplomatic l..."
entries.dialogueText: "They are requesting a diplomatic liaison for our gas deal. I said I knew just the woman for the job."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am sending you there to serve as..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am sending you there to serve as diplomatic liaison for the final stages of our gas agreement."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In order to maintain peaceful rela..."
entries.dialogueText: "In order to maintain peaceful relations with the Grand Duchy, it is vitally important that you travel there to oversee our gas deal."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Really?!""
entries.dialogueText: "Really?!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She hesitated."
entries.dialogueText: She hesitated.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Really?""
entries.dialogueText: "Really?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Suspicion flickered across her face..."
entries.dialogueText: Suspicion flickered across her face.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""You wouldn't let me onto your coun..."
entries.dialogueText: "You wouldn't let me onto your council, but you'd entrust me with important diplomatic duties?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Are you sure they'd want me, Fathe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you sure they'd want me, Father? I've never carried out any diplomatic duties before."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's mostly a symbolic role. Nothi..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's mostly a symbolic role. Nothing to it, really."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Like... a spy?""
entries.dialogueText: "Like... a spy?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You don't have a say in the matter..."
entries.dialogueText: "You don't have a say in the matter. You're going no matter what."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The council would have been no fun..."
entries.dialogueText: "The council would have been no fun for you. Pales will be an adventure."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Diplomatic duties should come seco..."
entries.dialogueText: "Diplomatic duties should come secondary. What I *actually* want you to do is keep an eye on Duke Reinhart."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Both Vina and Manus gaped at me in..."
entries.dialogueText: Both Vina and Manus gaped at me in surprise.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Why not? I already know you're goo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why not? I already know you're good at sneaking around."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Oh. A little like my current role,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh. A little like my current role, then."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If you can serve on the council, y..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you can serve on the council, you can do this. It's good preparation for being queen."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I... I'd love to.""
entries.dialogueText: "I... I'd love to."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked questioningly at Manus...."
entries.dialogueText: She looked questioningly at Manus. He nodded.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""That doesn't change what we were a..."
entries.dialogueText: "That doesn't change what we were about to ask you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus leaned forward to interject...."
entries.dialogueText: Manus leaned forward to interject. Vina shook her head.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I do want to go. But it would be n..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do want to go. But it would be nice if it was my choice."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I have a life in Porte Drazon. I'd..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have a life in Porte Drazon. I'd rather not leave it behind."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""And if I don't want to go?""
entries.dialogueText: "And if I don't want to go?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Well, if you think I'd be good at..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, if you think I'd be good at it..."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""But if you think it would help kee..."
entries.dialogueText: "But if you think it would help keep the peace with Pales, I'll do it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Please, Vina. It'll be for a year..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please, Vina. It'll be for a year at the very longest."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""But I do understand that royals do..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I do understand that royals don't always have that luxury. I will accept the task."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If you truly don't want to go, I'l..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you truly don't want to go, I'll send an envoy. But to be perfectly honest, I think you would be better at it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's you or nobody. You're the onl..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's you or nobody. You're the only person I trust enough for the job."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Then you should trust more people.""
entries.dialogueText: "Then you should trust more people."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I don't know about that. But if it..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't know about that. But if it means so much to you, I'll do it."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""A year is a long time, Father...""
entries.dialogueText: "A year is a long time, Father..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked questioningly at Manus...."
entries.dialogueText: She looked questioningly at Manus. He nodded.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""There's a reason I don't want to l..."
entries.dialogueText: "There's a reason I don't want to leave Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will respect your decision. I wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will respect your decision. I will not force you to go someplace you don't want to be."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Thank you, Father.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Father."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I... I have no idea what you mean.""
entries.dialogueText: "I... I have no idea what you mean."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Pales has been linked to the Frien..."
entries.dialogueText: "Pales has been linked to the Friendship Day bombing in Zille. I want you to find out more if you can."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Nothing that dramatic. Just let me..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nothing that dramatic. Just let me know if you see or hear anything suspicious."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If the deal goes south, we'll need..."
entries.dialogueText: "If the deal goes south, we'll need leverage. Try and dig up some dirt on the Duke."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I-- I see. It's a tall order, but..."
entries.dialogueText: "I-- I see. It's a tall order, but I can try."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I can do that.""
entries.dialogueText: "I can do that."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""And if I'd rather not?""
entries.dialogueText: "And if I'd rather not?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No buts. Go for it, you crazy kids.""
entries.dialogueText: "No buts. Go for it, you crazy kids."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked at me in confusion."
entries.dialogueText: She looked at me in confusion.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""What about Pales?""
entries.dialogueText: "What about Pales?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Pales? Why?""
entries.dialogueText: "Pales? Why?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked at me in confusion."
entries.dialogueText: She looked at me in confusion.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Still, I must say I have reservati..."
entries.dialogueText: "Still, I must say I have reservations about your future children carrying the name Sazon."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Do I have to have a reason? When I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do I have to have a reason? When I say no, I mean no."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What life? I thought you'd appreci..."
entries.dialogueText: "What life? I thought you'd appreciate the chance to get away from your old man."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked at Manus. He reached ove..."
entries.dialogueText: She looked at Manus. He reached over and squeezed her hand reassuringly.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""It's a wonderful opportunity, Your..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's a wonderful opportunity, Your Highness. You should take it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I would only ask that we refrain f..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would only ask that we refrain from publicizing your relationship until Vina's return."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked at Manus. He gave her a..."
entries.dialogueText: She looked at Manus. He gave her a reassuring glance.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am the King. If I order you to g..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am the King. If I order you to go, you'll go."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Defiance flashed in her eyes."
entries.dialogueText: Defiance flashed in her eyes.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I'll tell you what.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'll tell you what."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Give Manus and myself your officia..."
entries.dialogueText: "Give Manus and myself your official blessing, and I will do as you ask."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But I would ask that we only make..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I would ask that we only make the relationship public once Vina returns from Pales."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus reached over and squeezed Vin..."
entries.dialogueText: Manus reached over and squeezed Vina's hand.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus reached over and squeezed Vin..."
entries.dialogueText: Manus reached over and squeezed Vina's hand.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But Vina, there's something more i..."
entries.dialogueText: "But Vina, there's something more important I wanted to bring up with you. About Pales."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your mother and I put aside our tr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your mother and I put aside our true feelings for the good of the country. It's your turn now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Please, Vina. If you love your fat..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please, Vina. If you love your father and this country, you'll understand."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She seemed to think about it for a..."
entries.dialogueText: She seemed to think about it for a second.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're not a bargaining chip; you'..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're not a bargaining chip; you're a supremely intelligent young woman. Which is why you'll realize that making this relationship public right now will jeopardize my reign in the present and yours in the future."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""No. It's all bullshit! You don't c..."
entries.dialogueText: "No. It's all bullshit! You don't care about me, I'm just another one of your subjects..."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""All right, Father. I understand.""
entries.dialogueText: "All right, Father. I understand."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her shoulders slumped. Manus made a..."
entries.dialogueText: Her shoulders slumped. Manus made an attempt to appear cheerful.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Our time will come, my love. If no..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our time will come, my love. If not now, then someday."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Nobody spoke for a while. Eventuall..."
entries.dialogueText: Nobody spoke for a while. Eventually, the sound of faint industrial noises could be heard. We were nearing the Esqiris field.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This does not mean I approve of yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "This does not mean I approve of your relationship, though."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And you know what? I'll graciously..."
entries.dialogueText: "And you know what? I'll graciously allow you to begin dating in public. Effective immediately."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's not your choice, Vina. You wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's not your choice, Vina. You will go to Pales. And if I find out that Mr. Sazon has been trying to contact you, I'll have his head."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I wish I could approve. But it is..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wish I could approve. But it is politically advantageous for Vina to remain single at this point in time."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""What? But Father...""
entries.dialogueText: "What? But Father..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There will be no discussion. You'r..."
entries.dialogueText: "There will be no discussion. You're going to Pales, and you will break off contact with Mr. Sazon."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's a deal. Accept this position,..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's a deal. Accept this position, and you two can consider yourselves blessed."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""You could have opposed our relatio..."
entries.dialogueText: "You could have opposed our relationship, and you didn't. So I'll do as you ask."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Assuming Mr. Sazon is willing to w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Assuming Mr. Sazon is willing to wait for me, of course."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""For you, Your Highness, I would wa..."
entries.dialogueText: "For you, Your Highness, I would wait an eternity."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm sorry, both of you. But I can'..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry, both of you. But I can't give you my blessing to be together. It's too risky politically."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""You mean it?""
entries.dialogueText: "You mean it?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I do not want my grandchildren car..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do not want my grandchildren carrying the Sazon name."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This man's house is brimming with..."
entries.dialogueText: "This man's house is brimming with anti-monarchists. I want him as far from the throne as possible."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Perhaps He will approve if you agr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps He will approve if you agree to go to Pales."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You do. But I would ask that we on..."
entries.dialogueText: "You do. But I would ask that we only make the relationship public once Vina returns from Pales."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "It is God's will that you go to Pales."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina blinked."
entries.dialogueText: Vina blinked.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Pales? Why?""
entries.dialogueText: "Pales? Why?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hope one day that I can find a l..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope one day that I can find a love as pure as yours."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""But I thought -- well. I'm sure it..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I thought -- well. I'm sure it'll happen, Father."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He has ordained that the Toras fam..."
entries.dialogueText: "He has ordained that the Toras family will hold the throne for centuries to come. If you bear children with the Sazon name, it will ruin his plans."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It depends. Have you been fornicat..."
entries.dialogueText: "It depends. Have you been fornicating out of wedlock?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus turned beet red."
entries.dialogueText: Manus turned beet red.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Never, Your Majesty. I would not d..."
entries.dialogueText: "Never, Your Majesty. I would not defile the honor of the Princess of Rizia."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I can't believe either of you. If..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't believe either of you. If a woman's honor is tied to her maidenhead, I lost mine long ago while horseback riding."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
Princess Vina

entries.dialogueText: "You're asking a lot of me. But I can try."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
Paskal Beniwoll
Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "If you swear to abide by His laws and keep Him dear in your hearts... then yes, you do."

entries.dialogueText: "We do, Father. We will."

entries.dialogueText: "In the meantime, I regretfully turn down the Pales diplomatic position."

entries.dialogueText: "I understand. That's your prerogative."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Yes, it is.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, it is."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And why is that? Maybe some time a..."
entries.dialogueText: "And why is that? Maybe some time abroad will help you get a fresh perspective."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "No, you already agreed to it. You're going."

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: She looked at Manus. He didn't say anything.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""No. I'm doing enough for you alrea..."
entries.dialogueText: "No. I'm doing enough for you already, Father. You'll just have to find someone else."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked at Manus."
entries.dialogueText: She looked at Manus.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Your father is right, Your Highnes..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your father is right, Your Highness. Please don't reject this valuable opportunity on my account."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She sighed."
entries.dialogueText: She sighed.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Fine. I will go. But I hope you're..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fine. I will go. But I hope you're not expecting me to work miracles over there."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Come. Let all three of us behold t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Come. Let all three of us behold the majestic gas extraction capabilities of the Kingdom of Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm going to the bow to have a clo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm going to the bow to have a closer look. You may join if you wish."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus and Vina nodded to each other..."
entries.dialogueText: Manus and Vina nodded to each other, then got up from their seats and walked with me to the ship's bow.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They exchanged uneasy looks, then r..."
entries.dialogueText: They exchanged uneasy looks, then rose and walked to join me at the ship's bow.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The expanded gas field was a sight..."
entries.dialogueText: The expanded gas field was a sight to behold. A veritable city of metal drilling rigs rose out of the sea in front of us, connected by a labyrinth of platforms, cables and pipelines.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Even in its partially completed sta..."
entries.dialogueText: Even in its partially completed state, the expanded gas field was a sight to behold. Yellow-vested construction workers swarmed over a towering set of metal drilling rigs, connected by a labyrinth of platforms, cables and pipelines.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The decommissioning of the gas fiel..."
entries.dialogueText: The decommissioning of the gas field was still underway. Yellow-vested construction workers swarmed over the metal drilling rigs, uncoupling cables and dismantling pipelines.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""See, Vina? This is why it's so imp..."
entries.dialogueText: "See, Vina? This is why it's so important that the Pales deal goes smoothly. We can no longer rely on domestic gas production."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good thing we've got lots of energ..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good thing we've got lots of energy reserves to fall back on."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "See, Vina? This is why you should've agreed to help with the Pales deal. We can no longer rely on domestic gas production."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Well, Lord knows how we're going to meet all our energy needs now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "We've got to win that arbitration case now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "We're really going to need the Aureus field now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Good riddance. The ocean will flourish without it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Make sure to mention this when you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Make sure to mention this when you're in Pales, Vina. We have our own gas. We're not desperate for the Grand Duke's."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is why I'm not forcing you to..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is why I'm not forcing you to go to Pales, Vina. We've got plenty of our own gas to fall back on."

entries.dialogueText: "Hey Vina, remember when you were six and only wanted to eat cabbage for a week? When this baby's up and running, we'll have even more gas than that!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina blushed furiously."
entries.dialogueText: Vina blushed furiously.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Father! Must you?!""
entries.dialogueText: "Father! Must you?!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Hey Vina, remember when you were six and only wanted to eat cabbage for a week? Now that this baby's up and running, we'll have even more gas than that!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "This investment had better be worth it."

entries.dialogueText: "There's something strangely beautiful about it, isn't there?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina

entries.dialogueText: "Right, Father. I'll remember that."

entries.dialogueText: Vina didn't respond. She stared out at the sea in stony silence.

entries.dialogueText: "So I see. I hope the destruction of marine habitats is worth it."

entries.dialogueText: "Worth the destruction of marine habitats? I hope so too."

entries.dialogueText: "Mmm. I don't find anything beautiful about the destruction of marine habitats."

entries.dialogueText: "You'd rather we go back to coal and oil? This is the cleanest, safest energy source out there."

entries.dialogueText: "Except for my province's hydroelectric dam, of course. You have our thanks for that, Your Majesty."

entries.dialogueText: "Actually, so-called 'clean' hydroelectric plants still have a deleterious effect on river systems."

entries.dialogueText: "Greater energy independence is a win for all of us, Mr. Sazon."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "You're dam welcome."

entries.dialogueText: "I am glad your house appreciates my generosity."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Ugh. Must you, Father?""
entries.dialogueText: "Ugh. Must you, Father?"

entries.dialogueText: "Yes, both my house and the RPP are happy to see Rizia making progress on that front."

entries.dialogueText: "Oh. Well, I still consider it progress."

entries.dialogueText: "We do. And your eye towards progress."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon

entries.dialogueText: "There's still the Zpana hydroelectric dam. Which my family thanks you for, Your Majesty."

entries.dialogueText: "We'll get some energy from that plant. I wish it was more."

entries.dialogueText: "Agreed. We really ought to find a way to power ourselves without relying on dirty gas."

entries.dialogueText: "Speaking of which..."

entries.dialogueText: "Except yours, love."

entries.dialogueText: "Now, Vina. Natural gas is the cleanest, safest type of energy there is."

entries.dialogueText: "You're absolutely right. Coal and oil are the past. Natural gas is the future."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon

entries.dialogueText: "I would certainly call it progress."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Compared to coal and oil, I would..."
entries.dialogueText: "Compared to coal and oil, I would call it progress."

entries.title: Narrator: "Manus turned towards me, a strained..."
entries.dialogueText: Manus turned towards me, a strained smile on his face.

entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""While it's just the three of us, m..."
entries.dialogueText: "While it's just the three of us, may I take the opportunity to follow up on our conversation about reforming the country?"

entries.dialogueText: "So was I, after that talk we had in Monqiz."

entries.dialogueText: "'Do we really want the same thing? What about the dream of revolution you shared with Chancellor Hegel, Comrade Vina?"

entries.dialogueText: The Rizania completed a slow circle around the gas field and began heading back towards the Topes harbor.

entries.dialogueText: "Make the most of it, kids. Won't be long before Vina ships off to Pales."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is what you wanted. Prepare f..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is what you wanted. Prepare for Voice of Rizia to tear you to shreds."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The gossip columnists answer to th..."
entries.dialogueText: "The gossip columnists answer to the Crown, but they can still be vicious."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Of course everyone will accept you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course everyone will accept you. You're young, beautiful and heterosexual."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That I'm collaborating with the op..."
entries.dialogueText: "That I'm collaborating with the opposition? Heaven forbid."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't worry. It won't be long befo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't worry. It won't be long before you can step off the yacht arm in arm with Vina."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That I'm allowing the son of my ki..."
entries.dialogueText: "That I'm allowing the son of my kidnapper to court my daughter? Yes, genius, that would paint me in a weak light."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That the King of Rizia is engaged..."
entries.dialogueText: "That the King of Rizia is engaged in a torrid affair with a man half his age? No, that'd be dreadful."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""All I want is to neutralize potent..."
entries.dialogueText: "All I want is to neutralize potential revolutionary elements by giving them a greater say in the lawmaking process."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They both nodded."
entries.dialogueText: They both nodded.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They looked at each other. Vina gav..."
entries.dialogueText: They looked at each other. Vina gave a small nod.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Precisely, Your Majesty. And in do..."
entries.dialogueText: "Precisely, Your Majesty. And in doing so, we can finally empower the citizens of this kingdom."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A look of horror spread across my d..."
entries.dialogueText: A look of horror spread across my daughter's face. Manus took a step backwards.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I-- I was going to tell you. It's..."
entries.dialogueText: "I-- I was going to tell you. It's not what you think."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What I think is that you humiliate..."
entries.dialogueText: "What I think is that you humiliated me and undermined your government."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Relax. I'm not angry. Just disappo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Relax. I'm not angry. Just disappointed that you didn't confide in me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I had no idea that your hobby inte..."
entries.dialogueText: "I had no idea that your hobby interest in communism had gone this far."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Mr. Sazon, did you know your sweet..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Sazon, did you know your sweetheart here is a Malenyevist?"

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""She did bring up her readings with..."
entries.dialogueText: "She did bring up her readings with me, Your Majesty. We thought it safest that you didn't know."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""It's not a 'hobby', Father,""
entries.dialogueText: "It's not a 'hobby', Father,"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I'm sorry, Father. I thought it wa..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry, Father. I thought it was safer that you didn't know."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I know, Father. I truly am sorry.""
entries.dialogueText: "I know, Father. I truly am sorry."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""For what it's worth... I didn't te..."
entries.dialogueText: "For what it's worth... I didn't tell the Chancellor I wanted revolution. I asked him if he thought a country like Rizia could adopt Valgslandian Socialist principles without one."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Of course we can. In case you have..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course we can. In case you haven't noticed, I've been working day and night to better the situation of commoners."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't be daft. The aristocracy is..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't be daft. The aristocracy is blocking our way to true progress, and it is highly unlikely they'll gently step aside."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I think I know what his answer was.""
entries.dialogueText: "I think I know what his answer was."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And? What did he say?""
entries.dialogueText: "And? What did he say?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Of course we can. In fact, tacklin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course we can. In fact, tackling the plight of commoners is at the top of my agenda."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""He wrote that you can't heal an in..."
entries.dialogueText: "He wrote that you can't heal an infected tooth without tearing out its root."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""That's what he said. In so many wo..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's what he said. In so many words."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""But see, Father, true socialism is..."
entries.dialogueText: "But see, Father, true socialism is implemented from the bottom up. Not the top down."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I convinced Her Highness that she..."
entries.dialogueText: "I convinced Her Highness that she should talk to you rather than continue her correspondence."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Very well, Comrade. Talk to me.""
entries.dialogueText: "Very well, Comrade. Talk to me."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""We've had our disagreements about..."
entries.dialogueText: "We've had our disagreements about what that means. In the end, Her Highness made a compelling argument for removing the Rizian aristocracy's political power."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""We both believe that this can be a..."
entries.dialogueText: "We both believe that this can be accomplished without fundamentally disrupting Rizia's societal structure."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""In turn, Manus convinced me that s..."
entries.dialogueText: "In turn, Manus convinced me that such a transition can occur gradually, without the need for societal upheaval."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're a sensible man, Mr. Sazon...."
entries.dialogueText: "You're a sensible man, Mr. Sazon. A good match for my headstrong daughter."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Yes. The royal family and the nobl..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. The royal family and the noble houses should guide Rizians through the transition, not abandon them to it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So you'd ask the aristocracy to ju..."
entries.dialogueText: "So you'd ask the aristocracy to just politely step aside? It'll never happen."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I thought for a second you two wer..."
entries.dialogueText: "I thought for a second you two were going to start advocating for a revolution."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're a sensible man, Mr. Sazon...."
entries.dialogueText: "You're a sensible man, Mr. Sazon. A good match for my headstrong daughter."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're right. I should have stoppe..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're right. I should have stopped media censorship in Rizia as soon as I took the throne."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I keep journalists under control f..."
entries.dialogueText: "I keep journalists under control for my family's sake. Do you know what lies they'd spread about my daughter if they were let off their leash?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Can't I keep just a little censors..."
entries.dialogueText: "Can't I keep just a little censorship? A king is entitled to keep certain aspects of his private life private, after all."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""That will undermine the cause, You..."
entries.dialogueText: "That will undermine the cause, Your Majesty. Rizians need an information source they can trust."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I appreciate that you kept me out..."
entries.dialogueText: "I appreciate that you kept me out of the papers during my childhood, Father. But I'm not a little girl anymore."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""It has been too long since the Riz..."
entries.dialogueText: "It has been too long since the Rizian people had an information source they could trust."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I disagree. Any change has got to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I disagree. Any change has got to be radical, or it's not going to stick."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Look at what's going on around us,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Look at what's going on around us, Father. Rizia needs change, but we also need stability."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Go too radical too fast, and you w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Go too radical too fast, and you won't live long enough to see it through."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I'm standing right here, Father.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm standing right here, Father."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Not all at once.""
entries.dialogueText: "Not all at once."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We had reached the far edge of the..."
entries.dialogueText: We had reached the far edge of the gas field. The yacht creaked a little as it began to turn around.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What is there to say? It seems lik..."
entries.dialogueText: "What is there to say? It seems like your mind has been made up."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I'm right here, Father.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm right here, Father."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He rested his elbows on the ship's..."
entries.dialogueText: He rested his elbows on the ship's railing.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""On the other hand, if the Rizian P..."
entries.dialogueText: "On the other hand, if the Rizian People's Party were in power, you would have a much easier time of it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""First you want my daughter, then y..."
entries.dialogueText: "First you want my daughter, then you want a parliament majority. Why don't I hand you my crown while I'm at it?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I can't help you with that, Mr. Sa..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't help you with that, Mr. Sazon. If the people want you to win, you'll win."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""You know that's not how it works...."
entries.dialogueText: "You know that's not how it works. The system is rigged against the opposition."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If you win, you'll be the head pup..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you win, you'll be the head puppets in our puppet parliament. How will that change anything?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""May I just remind you that I'm not..."
entries.dialogueText: "May I just remind you that I'm not yours to 'give'?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You want me to rig the election? T..."
entries.dialogueText: "You want me to rig the election? That doesn't sound like you."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""The system is already rigged. We'r..."
entries.dialogueText: "The system is already rigged. We're asking you to un-rig it."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Listen. The makeup of the House of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Listen. The makeup of the House of Delegates is determined by the outcome of the provincial council elections, right?"

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""You were the one who wanted change..."
entries.dialogueText: "You were the one who wanted change, Your Majesty. It'll never happen with de Rava and the RNC in charge."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""For the sake of a free press, I'm..."
entries.dialogueText: "For the sake of a free press, I'm willing to give up some of my privacy. I just won't read what they print about me."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Besides, Father, what do you even..."
entries.dialogueText: "Besides, Father, what do you even have to hide?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I most certainly didn't pervert th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I most certainly didn't pervert the justice system to serve my own ends."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'd rather not say.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'd rather not say."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Absolutely nothing. But that's not..."
entries.dialogueText: "Absolutely nothing. But that's not the point."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I do realize that opens us up to m..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do realize that opens us up to more public scrutiny. But I'm not a little girl anymore."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I have one other idea. My party ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have one other idea. My party has millions of sympathizers in Rizia who cannot vote for us because they are not citizens."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus and Vina politely pretended n..."
entries.dialogueText: Manus and Vina politely pretended not to hear me.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Now you're *really* trying to get..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now you're *really* trying to get me overthrown."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Giving up some of our privacy now..."
entries.dialogueText: "Giving up some of our privacy now will be worth it in the long run. I bet the papers won't even care about us royals once we're merely symbols."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're probably right.""
entries.dialogueText: "You're probably right."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You'd be surprised.""
entries.dialogueText: "You'd be surprised."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""And as you know, there's an electi..."
entries.dialogueText: "And as you know, there's an election coming up."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""The vast majority of the RPP is in..."
entries.dialogueText: "The vast majority of the RPP is in favor of reform. The more power we hold -- even if it's only symbolic power -- the stronger the movement becomes."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A sound strategy. The RPP would be..."
entries.dialogueText: "A sound strategy. The RPP would be able to increase its voter base overnight."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's a rubbish tactic. The backl..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's a rubbish tactic. The backlash from real Rizians would cancel out any benefit you got from the foreign vote."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""The high-ranking members of your h..."
entries.dialogueText: "The high-ranking members of your house won't like it. But the rest of Rizia will."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Rumburgians and ethnic Valgs would..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rumburgians and ethnic Valgs would lean monarchist. But if we mobilize the Wehzek, Derdian and Morellan base now, we should gain enough votes to come out on top."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""'Real' Rizians, Father? What do yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "'Real' Rizians, Father? What do you call the children of Wehzek civil war refugees who have never known any other home?'"

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""It is a risk, Vina. Especially wit..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is a risk, Vina. Especially with Su Omina on the rise."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I know it's a risk. Especially wit..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know it's a risk. Especially with Su Omina on the rise."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Such an act wouldn't only benefit..."
entries.dialogueText: "Such an act wouldn't only benefit my party, you know. Quite a few Rumburgians and ethnic Valgs will opt for the Rizian National Coalition."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""But if we start moblizing the Wehz..."
entries.dialogueText: "But if we start moblizing the Wehzek, Derdian and Morellan base now, we should gain enough votes to come out on top."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Rizia is a multicultural country,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia is a multicultural country, Your Majesty. It's time for our government to reflect that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Vina, what do you think of this id..."
entries.dialogueText: "Vina, what do you think of this idea?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Leave me to handle Su Omina.""
entries.dialogueText: "Leave me to handle Su Omina."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm uneasy about this. I fear Rizi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm uneasy about this. I fear Rizian national identity will become diluted if just anyone can become a citizen."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Having the interests of the workin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Having the interests of the working class represented in government is more important to me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina straightened her back."
entries.dialogueText: Vina straightened her back.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I think it's long overdue. And it'..."
entries.dialogueText: "I think it's long overdue. And it's the fastest way to get Mr. Sazon's party into power. But at the same time..."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Rizia's foreigners mostly belong t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia's foreigners mostly belong to the working class, Your Majesty. So this will accomplish both."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Perhaps the acceptance of differen..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps the acceptance of different opinions and cultures should be part of our national identity, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I confess I'm worried about increa..."
entries.dialogueText: "I confess I'm worried about increasing numbers of Golcondists and Dastnurists participating in elections. What if it sets back the progress we've made on women's rights?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't worry. I am still the king,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't worry. I am still the king, and I make the rules in the end."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We shouldn't assume all Derdians a..."
entries.dialogueText: "We shouldn't assume all Derdians and Wehzeks hold those beliefs. Many moved here to get away from them."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Relax, Vina. The foreign vote will..."
entries.dialogueText: "Relax, Vina. The foreign vote will boost the RPP, but they're still far from the majority in this country."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""For now. But if we succeed in tran..."
entries.dialogueText: "For now. But if we succeed in transferring power to the Delegates..."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Well. We'll just have to see what..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well. We'll just have to see what happens."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I suppose you're right, Father...""
entries.dialogueText: "I suppose you're right, Father..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A legitimate concern, my daughter.""
entries.dialogueText: "A legitimate concern, my daughter."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Vina, as long as I'm still speaker..."
entries.dialogueText: "Vina, as long as I'm still speaker of the RPP, I will preserve the gender equality laws your great-grandmother made."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""And those passed by your father, o..."
entries.dialogueText: "And those passed by your father, of course."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus gave her a confident smile."
entries.dialogueText: Manus gave her a confident smile.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Well, Father? What do you think?""
entries.dialogueText: "Well, Father? What do you think?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Please. Call me Dad.""
entries.dialogueText: "Please. Call me Dad."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You may call me Romus.""
entries.dialogueText: "You may call me Romus."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Please don't, love.""
entries.dialogueText: "Please don't, love."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I still don't want you dating my d..."
entries.dialogueText: "I still don't want you dating my daughter, though."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You'd better not let me down. The..."
entries.dialogueText: "You'd better not let me down. The stakes are too high for all of us."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""That means so much. Thank you.""
entries.dialogueText: "That means so much. Thank you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina glowered at me. Manus nodded h..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina glowered at me. Manus nodded his assent.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I understand.""
entries.dialogueText: "I understand."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I know.""
entries.dialogueText: "I know."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I am sorry if I misunderstood your..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am sorry if I misunderstood your intentions, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I turned my gaze forward. The coast..."
entries.dialogueText: I turned my gaze forward. The coast of Topes was starting to come into view.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She crossed her arms."
entries.dialogueText: She crossed her arms.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""And by that time, I might just be..."
entries.dialogueText: "And by that time, I might just be House Speaker."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""The price of living in a free coun..."
entries.dialogueText: "The price of living in a free country."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina gave me a questioning look, bu..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina gave me a questioning look, but said nothing.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Let them chatter. I'm used to it b..."

entries.dialogueText: "Let them write what they will."

entries.dialogueText: "If they want gossip, we'll give them gossip."

entries.dialogueText: I allowed them a moment of privacy and retreated to the cabin to prepare for our arrival.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon

entries.dialogueText: "The time will pass quickly, love. And with luck, you'll return to a newly elected House Speaker."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon

entries.dialogueText: "The time will pass quickly, love. And I'll be right here when you return."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Of course everyone will accept you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course everyone will accept you. You're young, beautiful nobles."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina

entries.dialogueText: "Not that the 'noble' part should mean anything."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon

entries.dialogueText: "The time will pass in an instant, love."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""With luck, Your Majesty, I won't b..."
entries.dialogueText: "With luck, Your Majesty, I won't be the opposition for long."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""The next House of Delegates electi..."
entries.dialogueText: "The next House of Delegates elections are approaching, Your Majesty. I may not be the opposition for long."

entries.dialogueText: He turned to look into Vina's eyes.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon

entries.dialogueText: "I hope you're ready to come home to a House Speaker, Your Highness."

entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""The time will pass in an instant,..."
entries.dialogueText: "The time will pass in an instant, love."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon

entries.dialogueText: "This is not the end, Your Highness."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I did not mean to offend you in an..."
entries.dialogueText: "I did not mean to offend you in any way, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina

entries.dialogueText: "I'll make sure of it. The deal will go off without a hitch."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""A House Speaker and an accomplishe..."
entries.dialogueText: "A House Speaker and an accomplished diplomat. Quite the power couple."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Before Vina or I could respond, he..."
entries.dialogueText: Before Vina or I could respond, he swiftly made his exit down the stairs.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus kissed her passionately, then..."
entries.dialogueText: Manus kissed her passionately, then swiftly made his exit down the stairs.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina rolled her eyes."
entries.dialogueText: Vina rolled her eyes.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Nobody was in danger of thinking t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nobody was in danger of thinking that, Father."

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: She looked into Manus' eyes.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She turned to look into Manus' eyes..."
entries.dialogueText: She turned to look into Manus' eyes.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""This isn't over. I know it.""
entries.dialogueText: "This isn't over. I know it."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Halaita, Your Highness.""
entries.dialogueText: "Halaita, Your Highness."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""We'll be together soon. I know it.""
entries.dialogueText: "We'll be together soon. I know it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A few moments later, I heard the th..."
entries.dialogueText: A few moments later, I heard the thrum of the dinghy's engine, then a metallic clunk as it detached from the yacht's docking platform.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina slumped against the bow's rail..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina slumped against the bow's railing. I'd rarely seen her this forlorn.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Cheer up. It's not like anyone die..."
entries.dialogueText: "Cheer up. It's not like anyone died."

entries.dialogueText: "No. It hasn't."

entries.dialogueText: "Manus and I discussed this. I convinced him that his plan for a constitutional monarchy must involve taking power away from the Rizian aristocracy."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""And I convinced Her Highness that..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I convinced Her Highness that some amount of symbolic power is necessary to prevent total societal upheaval."

entries.title: Narrator: "After a while, faint industrial noi..."
entries.dialogueText: After a while, faint industrial noises began puncturing the quiet. We were nearing the Esqiris field.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "A few months in Pales will take your mind right off him."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Pining over a man? That's not the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Pining over a man? That's not the Vina I know."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
