entries.dialogueText: I didn't say anything to her.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Yes. Right.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. Right."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I'll be in the cabin. Fetch me whe..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll be in the cabin. Fetch me when we reach Topes."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""But I don't want to take my mind o..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I don't want to take my mind off him."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Then I suppose you don't know me,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then I suppose you don't know me, do you?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Nor the Vina I know. But what can..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nor the Vina I know. But what can I do?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Please, Father. You're making it w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please, Father. You're making it worse."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Never mind. You wouldn't understan..."
entries.dialogueText: "Never mind. You wouldn't understand."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After a while, she turned away. She..."
entries.dialogueText: After a while, she turned away. She seemed as if she could barely stand to look at me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The two of us stood there in silenc..."
entries.dialogueText: The two of us stood there in silence, watching the little boat as it disappeared towards shore.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She stormed away."
entries.dialogueText: She stormed away.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I stayed where I was, watching the..."
entries.dialogueText: I stayed where I was, watching the little boat as it disappeared towards shore.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We stood there for a while, watchin..."
entries.dialogueText: We stood there for a while, watching the little boat as it disappeared towards shore.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sorry, but you don't get to choose..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry, but you don't get to choose that either. You're going to Pales."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You've both gone mad. Changing the..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've both gone mad. Changing the election process would represent a massive break with tradition."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And what if it backfires? What if..."
entries.dialogueText: "And what if it backfires? What if the Rizian National Coalition is what the people really want?"

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""There's only one way to find out.""
entries.dialogueText: "There's only one way to find out."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If I do that, members of all three..."
entries.dialogueText: "If I do that, members of all three noble houses might lose their council positions. Including House Sazon, by the way."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""What tradition, Your Majesty? The..."
entries.dialogueText: "What tradition, Your Majesty? The House of Delegates is younger than I am."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Your Majesty, the wider the discon..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, the wider the disconnect between nobles like yourself and the actual citizenry of this country, the greater the potential for actual chaos."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I know. But if the electorate does..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know. But if the electorate doesn't want them there, they don't deserve to be there."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I told you this was a pipe dream,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I told you this was a pipe dream, Manus. Father's afraid of finding out what everyone really thinks of us royals."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Just imagine, Father. Haven't you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just imagine, Father. Haven't you always wanted to know what everyone really thinks of us?"

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""But as long as the provinces' ruli..."
entries.dialogueText: "But as long as the provinces' ruling nobles appoint half of the councilors themselves -- overriding the people's wishes -- the monarchists in the RNC will always have an unfair advantage."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina nodded in agreement."
entries.dialogueText: Vina nodded in agreement.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Take away that power, and the Hous..."
entries.dialogueText: "Take away that power, and the House of Delegates will truly be a parliament of the people. All you have to do is expand the election process to apply to all provincial council appointees."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Say what you will about the nobles..."
entries.dialogueText: "Say what you will about the nobles, but they've provided our kingdom with stability and continuity. If just anyone can become a councilor, chaos will reign."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Aren't we better off not knowing?..."
entries.dialogueText: "Aren't we better off not knowing? We should rule according to what we believe is just and fair, not bow to the tyranny of the majority."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm not afraid. I already know tha..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not afraid. I already know that our populace loves us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I already know that our populace l..."
entries.dialogueText: "I already know that our populace loves us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're wrong. I have long believed..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're wrong. I have long believed that the king should be on the same level with his subjects, not stand head and shoulders above them."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Of course. I have long believed th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course. I have long believed that the king should be on the same level with his subjects, not stand head and shoulders above them."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There is only one judgement I am w..."
entries.dialogueText: "There is only one judgement I am worried about. That of God."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Then you'll have nothing to worry..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then you'll have nothing to worry about."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Exactly. Only when the Rizian roya..."
entries.dialogueText: "Exactly. Only when the Rizian royalty becomes part of ordinary society can we bring everyone together."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I have faith that the majority of..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have faith that the majority of Rizians want justice as well."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""But would God not want you to serv..."
entries.dialogueText: "But would God not want you to serve according to the needs of your subjects?"

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I understand that it will not be e..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand that it will not be easy to pass a decree of this magnitude. If we want it done before the elections, we may need help."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus shook his head sadly."
entries.dialogueText: Manus shook his head sadly.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Change will find its way to us. Wh..."
entries.dialogueText: "Change will find its way to us. Whether we are the ones behind it or not."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus' expression turned thoughtful..."
entries.dialogueText: Manus' expression turned thoughtful.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""You've allowed the Voice of Rizia..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've allowed the Voice of Rizia to resume publication. That alone will sway many people to our side."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""We all know that the Royal Herald..."
entries.dialogueText: "We all know that the Royal Herald is extremely biased in favor of the RNC. Allowing the publication of independent newspapers would definitely help sway the electorate."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""And several million Rizians of for..."
entries.dialogueText: "And several million Rizians of foreign origin have now become naturalized citizens."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""You've already passed one decree t..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've already passed one decree that will help us greatly. Thanks to you, millions of foreign-born Rizians have become naturalized citizens."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""You have the power to allow them t..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have the power to allow them to be naturalized as Rizians."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Rumburgians and ethnic Valgs will..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rumburgians and ethnic Valgs will lean monarchist. But if we mobilize the Wehzek, Derdian and Morellan base now, we should have a significant edge compared to the last elections."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I think those measures are a drop..."
entries.dialogueText: "I think those measures are a drop in the bucket compared to the election reform you mentioned. Once we get off this boat, I'm passing a decree democratizing the Rizian election process."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina

entries.dialogueText: "Our opinions on the subject may differ, but in the end, all three of us share the same goal."

entries.dialogueText: "We can get into the specifics later. But it is safe to say that any meaningful reform will require a delegation of legislative control by the King of Rizia."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We must proceed carefully. I would..."
entries.dialogueText: "We must proceed carefully. I wouldn't want any of the noble houses getting in the way."
